text.body: śrīviṣṇoḥ ṣoḍaśanāmastotram | śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ|| auṣadhe cintayedviṣṇuṃ bhojane ca janārdanam | śayane padmanābhaṃ ca vivāhe ca prajāpatim ||1|| yuddhe cakradharaṃ devaṃ pravāse ca trivikramam | nārāyaṇaṃ tanutyāge śrīdharaṃ priyasaṃgame ||2|| duḥsvapne smara govindaṃ saṃkaṭe madhusudanam | kānane nārasiṃhaṃ ca pāvake jalaśāyinam ||3|| jalamadhye varāhaṃ ca parvate raghunandanam | gamane vāmanaṃ caiva sarvakāryeṣu mādhavam ||4|| ṣoḍaśaitāni nāmāni prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet | sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||5|| iti śrīviṣṇoḥ ṣoḍaśanāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam||
